ABOUT-ME.lead: Most developers learn to code first and the domain second. For me it was the other way round.
ABOUT-ME.p1: What that means for you: I can talk to your specialists without anyone needing to translate. I understand why an organisation does things the way it does, and I know what an interface has to look like so that it also works for an 82-year-old or a volunteer with no IT experience. Nobody has to translate requirements into ready-made tickets for me.
ABOUT-ME.p2: That's because I learned it the other way round. Several years as a social worker, two academic further-education programmes in Applied Gerontology, and at a community centre I digitised the workflows: room and booking scheduling, moving from paper to digital, with everything that involves. Convincing staff, bringing volunteers along, adapting the software to reality instead of the other way round. After that I taught myself development: JavaScript, Angular, TypeScript, then Python, Django and REST APIs.
ABOUT-ME.p3: Before that: mechatronics technician. And since 2024 I've been working in retail on the side – everyday work in which I see first-hand how much processes depend on whether the software fits the people using it.

CAREER-TEASER.intro: Four stops rarely found in one person: mechatronics, social work, gerontology, software development. Each one contributed something I still use every day.

SKILL-SET.intro: From frontend into backend: JavaScript and Angular, then Python, Django and REST APIs. I set up and deployed my projects on my own server myself instead of relying on a hosting service – I want to know what's underneath the framework.
SKILL-SET.question-1: Looking for something you don't see here?
SKILL-SET.answer: Feel free to write to me. I get up to speed on new stacks quickly.

PROJECTS.text: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.

Project.description-project-1: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
Project.description-project-2: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
Project.description-project-3: This App is a Slack Clone App. It revolutionizes team communication and collaboration with its intuitive interface, real-time messaging, and robust channel organization.
Project.description-project-4: Netflix-like video streaming backend built with Django and Django REST Framework. User registration with email activation, JWT login, password reset and video management – fully containerized with Docker, PostgreSQL and Redis.

COLLEAGUES-VOICES.header: What my colleagues say about me

card-1.text: Mr. Wezel digitalized the workflows at the community center and had a real talent for understanding how staff and volunteers could work with them efficiently.

card-2.text: Richard always tries to understand why customers do things before creating a solution for them. A real asset!

card-3.text: Richard sees what needs to be done and finds himself new tasks when things are quiet.

invitation-to-contact-me.header: Looking for someone to join your team?
invitation-to-contact-me.text: I'm not looking for client projects but for a team: a permanent position where I can combine development with my background in the social sciences – in research projects, at software vendors for the social and care sector, or with organisations digitising their processes.
invitation-to-contact-me.textSecondary: I'd rather work in a team than on my own, and bring experience bridging domain expertise and technology. Based in Freiburg – remote or hybrid works just as well.

home.description: Full-stack developer (Angular, Python, Django) with a background in social work and gerontology. Software for the social sector. Looking for a permanent role – Freiburg & remote.

CV-TIMELINE.label: My Path
CV-TIMELINE.intro: From the software development retraining back to the mechatronics apprenticeship in 2007. A lot ran in parallel – apprenticeship and evening school, degree and second certificate, a management role and two advanced studies programmes. The line shows the main path; the offset cards next to it show what ran alongside.

summary.parallel: ran in parallel to a main station

mecha.m: Dual apprenticeship at one of Germany's largest public transport operators – theory at vocational school, practice in-house.
mecha.lead: The combination of vocational school and solid hands-on training in the company proved its worth: broadly skilled across the whole trade, with plenty of craft instead of pure theory.
mecha.ab: IHK final examination overall result "good" (82 points). Company project very good (97 points), work planning good (84), economics and social studies good (83). Vocational school average 2.6.
px: Company project with 97 out of 100 points – the strongest single result of the exam.
Automated subsystems: commissioning and systematic troubleshooting on real installations.
PLC programming and pneumatics as the first encounter with logic and control – the same way of thinking that carries programming today.

fhr.m: Three years of evening school Thursday to Saturday – every week, alongside the full-time apprenticeship.
fhr.lead: Three years back at school in parallel to a full-time apprenticeship: Thursday to Saturday, every week. What stands out is less the subject matter than the perseverance.
px: Three years of uninterrupted Thu–Sat classes on top of the training company.
The qualification was the ticket for everything that followed – without it no Abitur, no degree.

fokolar.m: Looked after children's and youth groups aged 8 to 18, organised camps, accompanied international meetings.
fokolar.lead: Years of accompanying children's and youth groups – from regular afternoons and weekends to trips abroad in Europe. This laid the foundation for the later educational work.
px: Co-organised camps and weekends for groups of 8- to 18-year-olds independently.
Accompanied trips to international meetings across Europe.
The movement provided the contact that later made the language stay in Perugia possible.
fokolar.zg: The commitment predestines him for a career choice and a degree in the educational field.

bvg.m: Inspection, maintenance and repair of underground trains – working to schedule and on piece rate.
bvg.lead: A year of responsibility on large-profile vehicles: running inspections, finding defects, repairing components. Understanding the entire maintenance process was particularly appealing – knowing when what needs to be done on a train.
px: Repair of defective components on large-profile vehicles under piece-rate conditions.
Regular inspections and quality control according to a fixed maintenance schedule.
Early shift from 6 a.m. for a whole year – the experience that triggered the deliberate change of direction.
bvg.zg: Solid specialist knowledge, found his way in new situations and grasped complicated relationships. Commitment and initiative, even under heavy workload. Conduct impeccable.

ims.o: IMS Personal GmbH – Bielefeld, Dassel, Schwäbisch Gmünd
ims.m: Changing industrial assignments: wired a substation, cabled a university building, converted hall lighting to LED.
ims.lead: Six weeks of assembly work at three locations: each time a new hall, new team, new task. A tough school in flexibility and independent travel organisation.
px: Wiring of a large substation for a smelting plant.
High-voltage installation in a university building.
Lighting conversion in a ZF hall: remove halogen, adapt wiring, mount LED – from the lifting platform.

perugia.m: Four months of language course A2 → B1 in Italy, in an Italian-speaking flat share instead of a fallback language.
perugia.lead: Four months in Perugia: language course from A2 to B1, plus a flat share with two Italians who barely spoke English. Exactly this immersion made the difference – after four months it was enough for everyday conversations.
perugia.ab: Attestato di Conoscenza della Lingua Italiana, Corso Intermedio di Primo Livello (B1 CEFR), grade 23/30, Università per Stranieri di Perugia, 4 July 2012.
px: Enrolment and de-registration at the Italian university organised entirely on my own – without support from home.
Researched independently which requirements (4 months, 120 teaching units) were needed for recognition towards the general university entrance qualification.
Flat share without a shared third language – Italian was the only way.

abi.m: One year of full-time Abitur via second-chance education – with Italian as second foreign language.
abi.lead: After apprenticeship, job and evening school, another year of full-time school: mathematics beyond tenth-grade level, metal technology with CAD design, politics and history. All classmates were there voluntarily – that shaped the atmosphere.
abi.ab: General University Entrance Qualification, average 2.2 (7 June 2013). Research paper "Commons as a future trend?". Final grades incl. politics/history 13, German 11, chemistry 11, technology 11 points. Entitles to study all degree programmes.
px: CAD design drawings that could theoretically be executed directly on a machining centre.
Research paper on commons as a future trend – the first own longer academic paper.
The decisive thing in hindsight: adding the Abitur on top of apprenticeship and job and seeing it through.

dgbschul.m: Group psychology, methods of youth education work, legal basics, own practical assignment.
dgbschul.lead: Six days of compact qualification: self-image as a group leader, group processes, conflict resolution, communication basics and the legal side from youth protection to duty of supervision.
dgbschul.ab: Certificate of attendance from the DGB youth education centre Kirschallee, Flecken Zechlin, 5 July 2013 – successful participation confirmed.
px: Planning, organisation and delivery of an own practical assignment as examination performance.
Gender-differentiated approaches in youth work – a perspective that later helped in seminar work.

eosbfd.o: EOS Erlebnispädagogik e.V., Villa Mez Freiburg
eosbfd.m: Marketing, materials management and driving services – at times solely responsible for an entire department.
eosbfd.lead: The move to Freiburg and the entry into the social sector. After the department head left, temporarily solely responsible for marketing, then assistance in pedagogy and, from the second half, driving services to holiday camps and school trips.
px: Helped build a new management system for outdoor education materials: several lockable chambers, one chamber per event with a fixed, always identically restocked material set – concept, setup and ongoing maintenance.
Filtered mailing logistics in Excel: which letters go via the regional service provider and which via regular post – separated by postcode.
Obtained a driving licence during the volunteer service from own savings and, from the first day after the test, independently drove people and materials on vehicles with very different mechanics.
eosbfd.zg: Good learning and work motivation, quick to grasp, coped well even with difficult tasks. Communication and organisational skills significantly expanded. Very good interpersonal skills, always ready to cooperate.

eoscert.m: Nine themed weekends, three hard skills, two placements and an own holiday camp as final project.
eoscert.lead: A year of part-time certification alongside the volunteer service, 380 teaching units. The core: learning how to create memorable experiences for children and young people – and discovering the ability to stand confidently in front of large groups.
eoscert.ab: Certificate "Certified Outdoor Educator EOS", course Spirit 2, successfully completed on 19 Oct 2014, 380 units. Final project: holiday camp "Robin Hood".
px: Final project holiday camp "Robin Hood" – one week, as leader on own responsibility.
Daily routine following the "head, heart, hand" concept: waking with guitar and songs, shared breakfast, workshops, evening ritual.
Organised and led night hikes with torches, campfires and singing.
Cooked for 40 to 100 people in the kitchen team – one of the surprisingly most formative experiences.
Hard skills: mobile rope courses, cooperative adventure games, archery – plus slackline, fire making and shelter building.

dgbarbeit.m: Assignments spread over four years: seminars for school classes and for trainee educators.
dgbarbeit.lead: Not a continuous employment, but sporadic assignments over almost four years – from single days to whole weeks, as needed. Exactly this on-call form combined well with studies and other activities.
px: Designed and delivered seminars for school classes.
Seminar work with trainee educators – a target group with professional self-interest.

ba.o: Catholic University of Applied Sciences Freiburg
ba.m: State-recognised social worker – with a gerontological focus already in the bachelor's thesis.
ba.lead: Five years of study with a clear gain: understanding how people act and why, social legislation and the welfare system, professional approaches in case management, solving social problems on different levels. A particular enthusiasm for sociology.
ba.ab: Bachelor of Arts, overall grade "good" (2.0), completed 3 Sep 2019. Bachelor's thesis "The view from the life phase of emerging adulthood onto the third age. Prospective ideas of students on shaping relationships with their ageing parents compared to today's forms" – grade 1.5 (very good). Individual grades incl. professional ethics 1.0, project work 1.0, media in social work 1.3.
px: Met voluntarily in free time with the sociology professor and around six other students to discuss sociological topics.
Practical and creative study elements: theatre course, exercises on leading youth groups, video review seminar.
The bachelor's thesis combined youth and ageing research – and thus laid the trail to the later specialisation.

isag.o: Catholic & Protestant University of Applied Sciences Freiburg
isag.m: Interdisciplinary additional programme alongside the bachelor's – 39 ECTS on top of the compulsory curriculum.
isag.lead: A complete additional programme in parallel to the regular bachelor's: own term papers, extra seminars, a compulsory placement in the gerontological field and a gerontology-oriented bachelor's thesis. The professional core of the later specialisation.
isag.ab: Certificate "Interdisciplinary Focus Applied Gerontology", Freiburg 29 Jan 2020, after a one-hour final colloquium. Additional module "Complex care and support processes" (9 ECTS, case examination) with grade 1.3.
px: Final colloquium of over an hour: 30 minutes compulsory area plus three elective fields of action of 10 minutes each.
Single event "The geriatric patient – an interprofessional challenge" at the Centre for Geriatrics and Gerontology of Freiburg University Hospital.
Elective area compiled independently: diagnostics/counselling, networking/planning, leadership/management.

eosfrei.m: Continued on a fee basis after the volunteer service: school trips and holiday camps during the first semesters.
eosfrei.lead: Translated the certification directly into paid assignments: led school trips and holiday camps on own responsibility during the first two to three semesters – as a freelancer, alongside studies.
px: Independent leadership of entire school trip and holiday camp weeks.
First experience with fee invoicing and independent acceptance of assignments.

casino.o: Casino Silvermine Red Devil GmbH, Freiburg
casino.m: Service, cash settlement, youth protection and ordering – and the impetus for the first academic term paper.
casino.lead: A side job that offered intellectually far more than expected: service and cash responsibility in a slot machine business, plus direct insights into gambling addiction dynamics – which flowed straight into the first term paper of the degree.
px: Wrote the first term paper of the degree on gambling addiction – developed directly from observation in the business.
Attended a mandatory seminar on addiction issues at a law firm.
Independent cash settlement and the ordering of drinks, food and prevention forms.
Entrance control and youth protection, camera surveillance, anti-manipulation checks – and opening and locking up the premises.
casino.zg: Completed the tasks with commitment and to our satisfaction; conduct was impeccable.
casino.zgSrc: Employment reference Red Devil GmbH, 12 July 2015

fahrgast.o: SNC-Lavalin Rail & Transit · PTV Transport Consult
fahrgast.m: Transport market research with app-based data collection on buses and trains.
fahrgast.lead: Two project-based assignments in transport market research: surveying passengers, digitally recording boarding and alighting stops and ticket types. The real training lay in approaching completely unprepared people.
px: Survey entirely on a smartphone survey device – a new technology at the time, mastered confidently in a short time.
Learned to win over even reluctant people and to deal with rejection objectively.
Accuracy under time pressure: incorrectly recorded stops render entire data sets worthless.

offenburg.o: City of Offenburg, District & Family Centre Oststadt
offenburg.m: Activating survey of an entire district – from flyer to residents' meeting, with a real outcome.
offenburg.lead: The professional highlight of the degree: a complete community work process in Offenburg's Oststadt, accompanied by an experienced graduate social worker. From the first flyer distribution to the residents' meeting in which residents themselves set priorities.
offenburg.ab: Compulsory placement in the B.A. Social Work, 100 attendance days full-time, completed with placement assessment. Remuneration €600 – above average for a university placement.
px: Developed and conducted an activating survey myself: designed and distributed flyers, interviewed district experts, held one-on-one conversations with residents, evaluated the survey.
Organised and moderated a residents' meeting and presented the results – problems were prioritised participatively and solutions developed together.
High-rise project: supported residents in standing up against grievances – empowerment with a visible result.
Walked the district physically to develop a feel for why things are the way they are there.
Weekly café for older people as a low-threshold offer – first contact with the later target group.

diakonie.m: Designed and delivered 25 mandatory seminar days for a volunteer-year group in a team of three.
diakonie.lead: A clearly defined fee-based assignment: accompanying 25 mandatory seminar days for a volunteer-year group together with two other outdoor educators. Facilitating exercises turned out to be my own, clearly recognisable strength.
px: Organised a wheelchair experience in the city – a change of perspective that made inclusion physically tangible.
Conducted a sailing trip as a team spirit experience.
Designed and held application training for the volunteer-year participants.
Designed morning energisers and openers, accompanied reflections on challenges at the volunteer placements.

richiclean.m: Built a small business with up to 12 clients out of a mini job – entirely through referrals.
richiclean.lead: Three years of real self-employment: from a single mini job, a client base of up to twelve private and office clients grew through word of mouth. Invoicing, taxes, scheduling and material procurement were entirely in my own hands – and financed the degree.
px: Recognised the issue of false self-employment myself, proactively sought advice and correctly registered the business with the tax office.
Calendar planning for twelve clients without overlaps – all appointments kept, no client losses, only growth.
Built invoicing and tax overview from scratch.
Financed the degree with it – along with the self-confidence that grew from it.

ordinariat.m: Full-time in payroll accounting for an employer with over 27,000 employees.
ordinariat.lead: Seven months full-time in central payroll accounting: checking and recording time supplements, creating new personnel cases in the HR management system, reconciling payment lists, checking master sheets. Structured office work with regular hours – and an excellent reference.
px: Creation of new personnel cases in the HR management system (PMS) of an employer with over 27,000 employees.
Reconciliation of payment lists and checking of salary master sheets – areas where accuracy counts directly.
Fully understood the entire payroll process including wage tax and social insurance.
ordinariat.zg: Particularly well-founded expertise and precise analytical skills, grasped even difficult situations. Exemplary initiative, reliable and resilient, found good solutions without exception – to our full recognition. We regret losing a good employee.

kurier.m: Holiday cover by bicycle: tissue samples from clinics and practices to the laboratory.
kurier.lead: A clearly limited holiday cover, cleanly done: collecting tissue samples from hospitals and practices, bringing them to the laboratory, filling in accompanying forms, helping out in the sorting office.
px: Took over the complete sample logistics of a cover – the employer was satisfied without reservation.
Time-critical medical materials by bicycle, across Freiburg and the region.

emmendingen.t: Social Pedagogue, ESF Project "Participation of Older People"
emmendingen.o: Caritas Association for the District of Emmendingen
emmendingen.m: First job after the degree: EU-funded project with budget responsibility, network building and senior education.
emmendingen.lead: The entry into the profession – and straight into my own specialisation: a European Social Fund project for the employment promotion of older people. Funding administration and funding guidelines on one side, real encounters and counselling on the other.
px: Managed the funds of an ESF project and was responsible for compliance with the funding guidelines.
Built a network with the employment agency, care homes and companies and acquired employers.
Conducted smartphone and technology consultations for seniors – talks and educational work that measurably helped.
Completed a care placement and thereby gained deep insights into the work of care staff.
Initiated a neighbourhood help scheme and later handed it over to a colleague in a structured way.
emmendingen.zg: Very positive employment reference (31 Aug 2021), plus confirmation of the ESF activity.

hhh.m: Overall responsibility for a community centre: programme, budget, team, volunteers, digitalisation.
hhh.lead: The fast rise: in the second job after the degree, overall responsibility for a community centre for older people – programme design, finances, staff management, volunteer coordination and external representation. And succeeding a predecessor who had shaped the house for 30 years.
px: Mastered change management: succeeding a manager after 30 years in office – without the house losing its character.
Converted room organisation and rental from a paper calendar to a digital system.
Built up smartphone and computer consultations for seniors – the help whose effect was most immediately visible.
Responsible for the programme with lunch table, singing groups, painting courses, instrument meetings, excursions and celebrations – including baking and pitching in myself.
Other facility managers regularly asked for my assessment – recognition from outside.
Responsible for data protection, fire safety and occupational safety for the house.

dasfr.t: DAS Ageing in the Social Space and Neighbourhood
dasfr.o: IWW, Catholic University of Applied Sciences Freiburg
dasfr.m: Part-time academic advanced training – module 1 of the joint master's in Applied Gerontology.
dasfr.lead: Academic advanced training in parallel to the management role: structural, political and legal foundations of ageing in the neighbourhood, education and social network work, plus an own teaching-research project.
dasfr.ab: Completed with a Diploma of Advanced Studies (DAS), 2 semesters plus final semester, 30 ECTS. The final thesis was at bachelor's thesis level. Module 1 of 2 for the M.A. joint master's in Applied Gerontology.
px: Conducted an own teaching-research project with learning support.
The content on municipal counselling and networking flowed directly back into the network work of the management role.

dasma.m: Second academic advanced training – module 2 of the joint master's, also part-time.
dasma.lead: The second pillar of the specialisation: general gerontology, geriatric psychiatry, intervention gerontology and research methods – with an academic project paper at bachelor's thesis level.
dasma.ab: Completed with a Diploma of Advanced Studies (DAS), 30 ECTS. Originally planned as a CAS; since both advanced trainings require an academic paper at bachelor's thesis level, the classification was harmonised. Module 2 of 2 for the M.A. joint master's in Applied Gerontology.
px: Academic project paper with own research question and methodology.
Geriatric psychiatry content met the everyday work in the community centre directly.

brand.m: Sole responsibility for the wine department – product presentation, stock, customer advice, sales rep appointments.
brand.lead: A year of full-time work in premium retail with a clearly own responsibility: the wine department. Product presentation, stock management, table island management, customer advice and sales rep appointments were entirely in my hands – it could be relied upon, and that was reflected back.
px: Sole responsibility for the entire wine department – the point of greatest pride.
Customer advice based on genuine wine expertise from my own hobby.
Guiding apprentices in day-to-day business.
Colleagues regularly asked for advice – a trusted person in the team, with praise from management.
Completed and applied training in occupational safety, hygiene standards and data protection.

umschulung.m: Frontend (JavaScript, Angular) and backend (Python/Django, REST) completed – capstone project Videoflix.
umschulung.lead: Since November 2023 the current step: turning the inclination towards structure, logic and process optimisation – which runs from PLC programming through Excel filtering to digitalising room management – into a profession. The wine department ran in parallel for one year of it.
umschulung.ab: Frontend (JavaScript, Angular) and backend (Python/Django, REST) completed. Capstone project Videoflix: a containerised video streaming backend with Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Redis and Docker.
px: Built this portfolio myself as an Angular application – including this timeline.
Join, El Pollo Loco and DaBubble as frontend projects: from vanilla JavaScript to Angular with Firebase.
Videoflix as backend capstone project: registration with email activation, JWT login, video management, Django RQ – fully containerised.

generalNotes.title: General information
generalNotes.content: The following information provides a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is all data with which you can be personally identified. Detailed information on the subject of data protection can be found in our data protection declaration listed below this text.

whoResponsible.title: Who is responsible for data collection on this website?
whoResponsible.content: Data processing on this website is carried out by the website operator. You can find the operator's contact details in the “Information on the controller” section of this privacy policy.

howCollectData.title: How do we collect your data?
howCollectData.content-1: On the one hand, your data is collected when you provide it to us. This may, for example, be data that you enter in a contact form.
howCollectData.content-2: Other data is collected automatically or with your consent by our IT systems when you visit the website. This is primarily technical data (e.g. internet browser, operating system or time of page view). This data is collected automatically as soon as you enter this website.

forwhatCollectData.title: For what purpose do we use your data?
forwhatCollectData.content: Some of the data is collected to ensure that the website is provided without errors. Other data can be used to analyze your user behavior.

rights.title: What rights do you have with regard to your data?
rights.content: You have the right to receive information about the origin, recipient and purpose of your stored personal data free of charge at any time. You also have the right to request the correction or deletion of this data. If you have given your consent to data processing, you can revoke this consent at any time for the future. You also have the right to request the restriction of the processing of your personal data under certain circumstances. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority. You can contact us at any time regarding this and other questions on the subject of data protection.

2-section.content: We host the content of our website with the following provider:

All-Inkl.title: All-Inkl
All-Inkl.content-1: The provider is ALL-INKL.COM - Neue Medien Münnich, Inh. René Münnich, Hauptstraße 68, 02742 Friedersdorf (hereinafter All-Inkl). Details can be found in All-Inkl's privacy policy:
All-Inkl.content-2: The use of All-Inkl is based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR. We have a legitimate interest in displaying our website as reliably as possible. If a corresponding consent has been requested, the processing is carried out exclusively on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR and § 25 para. 1 TDDDG, insofar as the consent includes the storage of cookies or access to information in the user's terminal device (e.g. device fingerprinting) within the meaning of the TDDDG. Consent can be revoked at any time.

data-privacy.title: Data protection
data-privacy.content-1: The operators of these pages take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with the statutory data protection regulations and this privacy policy.
data-privacy.content-2: When you use this website, various personal data is collected. Personal data is data that can be used to identify you personally. This privacy policy explains what data we collect and what we use it for. It also explains how and for what purpose this is done.
data-privacy.content-3: We would like to point out that data transmission over the Internet (e.g. when communicating by email) may be subject to security vulnerabilities. Complete protection of data against access by third parties is not possible.

NoteResponsibleBody.title: Note on the responsible body
NoteResponsibleBody.content-1: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
NoteResponsibleBody.phone: When you use this website, various personal data is collected. Personal data is data that can be used to identify you personally. This privacy policy explains what data we collect and what we use it for. It also explains how and for what purpose this is done.
NoteResponsibleBody.content-2: The controller is the natural or legal person who alone or jointly with others determines the purposes and means of the processing of personal data (e.g. names, email addresses, etc.).

StorageDuration.title: Storage duration
StorageDuration.content: Unless a more specific storage period has been specified in this privacy policy, your personal data will remain with us until the purpose for data processing no longer applies. If you assert a justified request for deletion or revoke your consent to data processing, your data will be deleted unless we have other legally permissible reasons for storing your personal data (e.g. retention periods under tax or commercial law); in the latter case, the deletion will take place after these reasons no longer apply.

generalNotesDataProcessingOnWeb.title: General information on the legal basis for data processing on this website
generalNotesDataProcessingOnWeb.content: If you have consented to data processing, we process your personal data on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR or Art. 9 para. 2 lit. a GDPR, insofar as special categories of data are processed in accordance with Art. 9 para. 1 GDPR. In the event of express consent to the transfer of personal data to third countries, data processing is also carried out on the basis of Art. 49 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. If you have consented to the storage of cookies or access to information in your end device (e.g. via device fingerprinting), the data processing is also carried out on the basis of Section 25 (1) TDDDG. Consent can be revoked at any time. If your data is required to fulfill the contract or to carry out pre-contractual measures, we process your data on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR. Furthermore, we process your data if this is necessary to fulfill a legal obligation on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. c GDPR. Data processing may also be carried out on the basis of our legitimate interest in accordance with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR. Information on the relevant legal bases in each individual case is provided in the following paragraphs of this privacy policy.

RecipientsOfPersonalData.title: Recipients of personal data
RecipientsOfPersonalData.content: As part of our business activities, we work together with various external bodies. In some cases, it is also necessary to transfer personal data to these external bodies. We only pass on personal data to external bodies if this is necessary for the fulfillment of a contract, if we are legally obliged to do so (e.g. passing on data to tax authorities), if we have a legitimate interest in the transfer in accordance with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR or if another legal basis permits the transfer of data. When using processors, we only pass on our customers' personal data on the basis of a valid contract for order processing. In the case of joint processing, a joint processing agreement is concluded.

Revocation.title: Revocation of your consent to data processing
Revocation.content: Many data processing operations are only possible with your express consent. You can withdraw your consent at any time. The legality of the data processing carried out until the revocation remains unaffected by the revocation.

RightsInSpecialCases.title: Right to object to the collection of data in special cases and to direct marketing (Art. 21 GDPR)
RightsInSpecialCases.content-1: IF THE DATA PROCESSING IS BASED ON ART. 6 ABS. 1 LIT. E OR F GDPR, YOU HAVE THE RIGHT TO OBJECT TO THE PROCESSING OF YOUR PERSONAL DATA AT ANY TIME ON GROUNDS RELATING TO YOUR PARTICULAR SITUATION; THIS ALSO APPLIES TO PROFILING BASED ON THESE PROVISIONS. THE RESPECTIVE LEGAL BASIS ON WHICH PROCESSING IS BASED CAN BE FOUND IN THIS PRIVACY POLICY. IF YOU OBJECT, WE WILL NO LONGER PROCESS YOUR PERSONAL DATA CONCERNED UNLESS WE CAN DEMONSTRATE COMPELLING LEGITIMATE GROUNDS FOR THE PROCESSING WHICH OVERRIDE YOUR INTERESTS, RIGHTS AND FREEDOMS OR THE PROCESSING SERVES THE ESTABLISHMENT, EXERCISE OR DEFENSE OF LEGAL CLAIMS (OBJECTION PURSUANT TO ART. 21 PARA. 1 GDPR).
RightsInSpecialCases.content-2: IF YOUR PERSONAL DATA ARE PROCESSED FOR THE PURPOSE OF DIRECT MARKETING, YOU HAVE THE RIGHT TO OBJECT AT ANY TIME TO THE PROCESSING OF PERSONAL DATA CONCERNING YOU FOR THE PURPOSE OF SUCH MARKETING; THIS ALSO APPLIES TO PROFILING TO THE EXTENT THAT IT IS RELATED TO SUCH DIRECT MARKETING. IF YOU OBJECT, YOUR PERSONAL DATA WILL SUBSEQUENTLY NO LONGER BE USED FOR THE PURPOSE OF DIRECT MARKETING (OBJECTION PURSUANT TO ART. 21 PARA. 2 GDPR).

RightToLodgeAComplaint.title: Right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority
RightToLodgeAComplaint.content: In the event of breaches of the GDPR, data subjects have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of their habitual residence, place of work or place of the alleged infringement. The right to lodge a complaint is without prejudice to other administrative or judicial remedies.

RightToDataPortability.title: Right to data portability
RightToDataPortability.content: You have the right to have data that we process automatically on the basis of your consent or in fulfillment of a contract handed over to you or to a third party in a common, machine-readable format. If you request the direct transfer of the data to another controller, this will only take place if it is technically feasible.

InformationCorrectionDeletion.title: Information, correction and deletion
InformationCorrectionDeletion.content: Within the framework of the applicable legal provisions, you have the right to free information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients and the purpose of the data processing and, if necessary, a right to correction or deletion of this data at any time. You can contact us at any time if you have further questions on the subject of personal data.

RightRestrictionProcessing.title: Right to restriction of processing
RightRestrictionProcessing.content-1: You have the right to request the restriction of the processing of your personal data. You can contact us at any time to do this. The right to restriction of processing exists in the following cases:
RightRestrictionProcessing.list-1: If you dispute the accuracy of your personal data stored by us, we generally need time to check this. You have the right to request the restriction of the processing of your personal data for the duration of the review.
RightRestrictionProcessing.list-2: If the processing of your personal data was/is carried out unlawfully, you can request the restriction of data processing instead of erasure.
RightRestrictionProcessing.list-3: If we no longer need your personal data, but you need it for the exercise, defense or assertion of legal claims, you have the right to request the restriction of the processing of your personal data instead of deletion.
RightRestrictionProcessing.list-4: If you have lodged an objection pursuant to Art. 21 (1) GDPR, a balance must be struck between your interests and ours. As long as it has not yet been determined whose interests prevail, you have the right to request the restriction of the processing of your personal data.
RightRestrictionProcessing.content-2: If you have restricted the processing of your personal data, this data - apart from its storage - may only be processed with your consent or for the establishment, exercise or defense of legal claims or for the protection of the rights of another natural or legal person or for reasons of important public interest of the European Union or of a Member State.

SSL.title: SSL or TLS encryption
SSL.content-1: This site uses SSL or TLS encryption for security reasons and to protect the transmission of confidential content, such as orders or inquiries that you send to us as the site operator. You can recognize an encrypted connection by the fact that the address line of the browser changes from “http://” to “https://” and by the lock symbol in your browser line.
SSL.content-2: If SSL or TLS encryption is activated, the data you transmit to us cannot be read by third parties.

cookies.content-1: Our Internet pages use so-called “cookies”. Cookies are small data packets and do not cause any damage to your end device. They are stored on your device either temporarily for the duration of a session (session cookies) or permanently (permanent cookies). Session cookies are automatically deleted at the end of your visit. Permanent cookies remain stored on your end device until you delete them yourself or they are automatically deleted by your web browser.
cookies.content-2: Cookies may originate from us (first-party cookies) or from third-party companies (so-called third-party cookies).Third-party cookies enable the integration of certain services from third-party companies within websites (e.g. cookies for processing payment services).
cookies.content-3: Cookies have various functions.Many cookies are technically necessary, as certain website functions would not work without them (e.g. the shopping cart function or the display of videos). Other cookies can be used to evaluate user behavior or for advertising purposes.
cookies.content-4: Cookies that are required to carry out the electronic communication process, to provide certain functions that you have requested (e.g. for the shopping cart function) or to optimize the website (e.g. cookies to measure the web audience) (necessary cookies) are stored on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR, unless another legal basis is specified. The website operator has a legitimate interest in the storage of necessary cookies for the technically error-free and optimized provision of its services.If consent to the storage of cookies and comparable recognition technologies has been requested, the processing is carried out exclusively on the basis of this consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR and § 25 para. 1 TDDDG); the consent can be revoked at any time.
cookies.content-5: You can set your browser so that you are informed about the setting of cookies and only allow cookies in individual cases, exclude the acceptance of cookies for certain cases or in general and activate the automatic deletion of cookies when closing the browser. If cookies are deactivated, the functionality of this website may be restricted.
cookies.content-6: You can find out which cookies and services are used on this website in this privacy policy.

ContactForm.title: Contact form
ContactForm.content-1: If you send us inquiries via the contact form, your details from the inquiry form, including the contact details you provide there, will be stored by us for the purpose of processing the inquiry and in the event of follow-up questions. We will not pass on this data without your consent.
ContactForm.content-2: This data is processed on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR if your request is related to the performance of a contract or is necessary for the implementation of pre-contractual measures.In all other cases, the processing is based on our legitimate interest in the effective processing of the inquiries addressed to us (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR) or on your consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR) if this has been requested; consent can be revoked at any time.
ContactForm.content-3: We will retain the data you provide on the contact form until you request its deletion, revoke your consent for its storage, or the purpose for its storage no longer pertains (e.g. after fulfilling your request).Mandatory statutory provisions - in particular retention periods - remain unaffected.

Requests.title: Request by e-mail, telephone or fax
Requests.contentn-1: If you contact us by e-mail, telephone or fax, we will store and process your inquiry, including all personal data (name, inquiry), for the purpose of processing your request. We will not pass on this data without your consent.
Requests.contentn-2: This data is processed on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR if your request is related to the performance of a contract or is necessary for the implementation of pre-contractual measures. In all other cases, the processing is based on our legitimate interest in the effective processing of the inquiries addressed to us (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR) or on your consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR) if this has been requested; consent can be revoked at any time.
Requests.contentn-3: The data you send to us via contact requests will remain with us until you ask us to delete it, revoke your consent to storage or the purpose for data storage no longer applies (e.g. after your request has been processed). Mandatory statutory provisions - in particular statutory retention periods - remain unaffected.
